summary: Terminal adjudication: narrow both unrelated-control observations to evidence-backed, reliably scoped checks; preserve fail-closed behavior when relevance is ambiguous.
nextAction: Use these bounded dispositions in existing launcher correction and independent review. Retain current release and attributed-launch gates; no change to the immutable review verdict.

1. Global visible picker count: NARROW. Source picker() lines 160-168 returns null unless document-wide visible matching buttons count is one. As a logical DOM counterexample, two visible matching buttons, one reliably unrelated, cause no selection even if the intended picker is otherwise provable. This was statically verified, not executed or observed live. Fixture duplicatePicker tests two matching controls without proving association; hiddenDuplicatePicker covers hidden only. Scope is prior explicitly accepted requirement to avoid rejecting harmless unrelated controls *where reliable association exists*, not universal support for arbitrary imagined page structures. Impact is pre-send unavailability with the additional visible control; likelihood is unestablished, no observed failed production launch. Authorized correction: where actual supported UI provides reliable evidence associating picker and composer, use that evidence and test a distinguishable unrelated visible control alongside a competing relevant or unprovable control that still fails closed. If no trustworthy association is available, retain fail-closed ambiguity and document evidence/limitation rather than guessing or requiring unsupported DOM structure. Reuse existing picker/surface checks and single-send fences; do not mandate a new architecture. Corrective Work may be created only within this bounded scope.

2. Ordinary-home Work labels: NARROW. At source line 524, non-project Work scans all document visible model-selection labels and rejects if any differs from Terra; diff confirms this broadens base behavior from requiring at least one matching label. A visible unrelated non-Terra label can logically trigger SelectedModelChanged despite a valid relevant Work selection. This is source-level conditional reasoning, not an executed reproduction or a demonstrated live regression; actual prevalence and reliable association are unknown. Scope: preserve existing valid Work and do not reject demonstrably unrelated evidence; genuine relevant contradiction remains a no-send failure. Authorized correction: constrain contradiction evidence to reliably relevant selection context where observable, add a meaningful offline unrelated-label case and a relevant-contradiction zero-send case when association can be proved; otherwise retain fail-closed behavior and document limitation. Reusing existing model-control evidence is preferable if it is authoritative on ordinary Work; do not blindly scope labels to the trigger if real ordinary Work exposes them elsewhere. Corrective Work may be created within this scope. Neither disposition accepts reviewer-suggested mechanism unconditionally, changes source acceptance or review verdict, or authorizes deployment.
